# Menubar

The File, Edit, View row of a desktop-style app. One tab stop, arrow keys across the menus, and once one is open the next opens on hover. The menus are Dropdown Menu's panels, so both read as one object.

```tsx
<Menubar>
  <MenubarMenu>
    <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
    <MenubarContent className="w-60">
      <MenubarItem>New document <MenubarShortcut>⌘N</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
      <MenubarItem>Open… <MenubarShortcut>⌘O</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
      <MenubarSeparator />
      <MenubarSub>
        <MenubarSubTrigger>Share</MenubarSubTrigger>
        <MenubarSubContent className="w-48">
          <MenubarItem>Copy link</MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem>Email a copy</MenubarItem>
        </MenubarSubContent>
      </MenubarSub>
      <MenubarSeparator />
      <MenubarItem variant="destructive">Move to trash <MenubarShortcut>⌘⌫</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
    </MenubarContent>
  </MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarMenu>
    <MenubarTrigger>Edit</MenubarTrigger>
    <MenubarContent>…</MenubarContent>
  </MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarMenu>
    <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
    <MenubarContent>…</MenubarContent>
  </MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarMenu>
    <MenubarTrigger>Settings</MenubarTrigger>
    <MenubarContent>…</MenubarContent>
  </MenubarMenu>
</Menubar>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add menubar
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/menubar/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import {
  Menubar,
  MenubarMenu,
  MenubarTrigger,
  MenubarContent,
  MenubarItem,
  MenubarShortcut,
} from "@/components/ui/menubar"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Menubar>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>
            New document <MenubarShortcut>⌘N</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
    </Menubar>
  )
}
```

## Variants

`outline` (the default) is the Toolbar's band: a 12px radius around 4px of padding and 8px triggers, so the corners nest concentrically, with an inset edge that takes no layout. `plain` drops the band for an app header that already owns one. Either way the open menu lights its trigger, so the bar always shows which menu you are in.

```tsx
<Menubar variant="outline">…</Menubar>
<Menubar variant="plain">…</Menubar>
```

## Checkbox, radio and switch rows

The rows are Dropdown Menu's: a checked row or the chosen radio carries the brand check on the right, on the same 12px edge line as the shortcuts. `variant="switch"` on a checkbox row draws a mini Switch there instead, for a setting that applies the moment it flips, and keeps the menu open so several can be flipped in a row.

```tsx
<MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
  <MenubarContent className="w-56">
    <MenubarCheckboxItem checked={ruler} onCheckedChange={setRuler}>Show ruler</MenubarCheckboxItem>
    <MenubarCheckboxItem checked={outline} onCheckedChange={setOutline}>Show outline</MenubarCheckboxItem>
    <MenubarSeparator />
    <MenubarLabel>Zoom</MenubarLabel>
    <MenubarRadioGroup value={zoom} onValueChange={setZoom}>
      <MenubarRadioItem value="75">75%</MenubarRadioItem>
      <MenubarRadioItem value="100">100%</MenubarRadioItem>
      <MenubarRadioItem value="150">150%</MenubarRadioItem>
    </MenubarRadioGroup>
  </MenubarContent>
</MenubarMenu>
<MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarTrigger>Settings</MenubarTrigger>
  <MenubarContent className="w-72">
    <MenubarCheckboxItem variant="switch" checked={autosave} onCheckedChange={setAutosave}>
      Autosave
    </MenubarCheckboxItem>
    …
  </MenubarContent>
</MenubarMenu>
```

## Density

The menus follow the density around the bar: 36px rows when comfortable, 32px when compact. React context crosses the portal the menus open in, so one `DensityProvider` around the bar sets every menu in it. The edge inset and the corners stay put at either density.

```tsx
<DensityProvider density="comfortable">
  <Menubar>…</Menubar>
</DensityProvider>
<DensityProvider density="compact">
  <Menubar>…</Menubar>
</DensityProvider>
```

## Keyboard

The whole bar is one tab stop. Left and Right move between menus, Down or Enter opens one, and once a menu is open, Left and Right (or the pointer) open its neighbours instead, the way an application menu behaves. Escape closes the menu and puts focus back on its trigger. Shortcuts are display only: bind the keys yourself.

## API reference

### Menubar

The bar, `role="menubar"`, over Radix `Menubar.Root`, and forwards its props. Every part accepts `className`, merged last.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | "outline" \| "plain" | "outline" | `outline` is the concentric band with an inset edge; `plain` drops it for a header that owns one. |
| value | string | - | The open menu's value, controlled. |
| defaultValue | string | - | The menu open on first render, uncontrolled. |
| onValueChange | (value: string) => void | - | Called when a menu opens or closes (an empty string when none is open). |
| loop | boolean | true | Arrow keys wrap from the last trigger to the first. |
| dir | "ltr" \| "rtl" | - | Reading direction for arrow-key navigation. |

### MenubarMenu

One menu: wraps its trigger and content. Radix `Menubar.Menu`, re-exported as is.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | string | - | Identifies the menu for the bar's `value`. Generated when omitted. |

### MenubarTrigger

The button that opens its menu; it lights while the menu is open. Forwards Radix `Menubar.Trigger` props.

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `open` while its menu is open, otherwise `closed`. |
| data-highlighted | Present while the trigger has keyboard focus. |
| data-disabled | Present when `disabled`. |

### MenubarContent

The menu panel, portalled to the body and built from Dropdown Menu's recipe. Forwards Radix `Menubar.Content` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| align | "start" \| "center" \| "end" | "start" | Alignment against the trigger. |
| alignOffset | number | -2 | Puts the rows' text on the trigger's text line. |
| sideOffset | number | 8 | Gap from the trigger, clearing the band's padding. |
| collisionPadding | number | 8 | Keeps the panel off the viewport edge. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | Row height (36 or 32px). Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` when unset. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `open` or `closed`, for the enter and exit animation. |
| data-side | The side the panel landed on after collision handling. |
| data-align | The resolved alignment. |

| CSS variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --radix-menubar-content-transform-origin | The point the panel scales from, set by Radix. |
| --radix-menubar-content-available-height | Room between the trigger and the viewport edge. |

### MenubarItem

A command row. Forwards Radix `Menubar.Item` props (`onSelect`, `disabled`, `textValue`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | "default" \| "destructive" | "default" | `destructive` turns the whole row red, icon included. |
| inset | boolean | false | Indents the text to line up with icon-bearing rows. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | Row height (36 or 32px). Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` when unset. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-highlighted | Present while the row is highlighted by pointer or keyboard. |
| data-disabled | Present when `disabled`. |
| data-inset | Present when `inset`. |

### MenubarCheckboxItem

A toggle row. Forwards Radix `Menubar.CheckboxItem` props (`checked`, `onCheckedChange`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | "check" \| "switch" | "check" | `check` is the brand check; `switch` is a mini Switch, for a setting that applies the moment it flips. |
| closeOnSelect | boolean | - | Closes the menu on toggle. Defaults to `true` for `check` and `false` for `switch`. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | Row height (36 or 32px). Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` when unset. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `checked`, `unchecked` or `indeterminate`. |
| data-highlighted | Present while the row is highlighted. |
| data-disabled | Present when `disabled`. |

### MenubarRadioGroup

Groups radio rows. Radix `Menubar.RadioGroup`, re-exported as is.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | string | - | The checked row's value. |
| onValueChange | (value: string) => void | - | Called when another row is picked. |

### MenubarRadioItem

One exclusive choice inside a `MenubarRadioGroup`, sharing the checkbox row's brand check. Forwards Radix `Menubar.RadioItem` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value* | string | - | The value the group reports. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | Row height (36 or 32px). Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` when unset. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `checked` or `unchecked`. |
| data-highlighted | Present while the row is highlighted. |

### MenubarLabel

A non-interactive heading over a run of rows. Forwards Radix `Menubar.Label` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| inset | boolean | false | Indents the text to line up with icon-bearing rows. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | Row height (36 or 32px). Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` when unset. |

### MenubarSeparator

A hairline between groups of rows. Forwards Radix `Menubar.Separator` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | Row height (36 or 32px). Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` when unset. |

### MenubarShortcut

The row's shortcut, a small `Kbd` chip on the right edge. Display only: bind the keys yourself. Forwards `Kbd` props.

### MenubarGroup

Groups related rows for assistive tech. Radix `Menubar.Group`, re-exported as is.

### MenubarSub

A nested menu: wraps a sub-trigger and its panel. Radix `Menubar.Sub`, re-exported as is.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | boolean | - | Controlled open state. |
| defaultOpen | boolean | - | Open on first render, uncontrolled. |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | Called when the submenu opens or closes. |

### MenubarSubTrigger

The row that opens a submenu, with a trailing caret. Forwards Radix `Menubar.SubTrigger` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| inset | boolean | false | Indents the text to line up with icon-bearing rows. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | Row height (36 or 32px). Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` when unset. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `open` while its submenu is open, otherwise `closed`. |
| data-highlighted | Present while the row is highlighted. |

### MenubarSubContent

The submenu panel, portalled to the body. Forwards Radix `Menubar.SubContent` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | Row height (36 or 32px). Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` when unset. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `open` or `closed`. |
| data-side | The side the panel landed on. |

### MenubarPortal

Radix `Menubar.Portal`, re-exported for custom panels. `MenubarContent` and `MenubarSubContent` already portal themselves.

## FAQ

### Menubar, Dropdown Menu or Toolbar?

A Menubar is a vocabulary of menus for an app with many commands (File, Edit, View). One menu behind a button is a Dropdown Menu. A row of icon actions, toggles and separators is a Toolbar.

### Do the menus look different from a Dropdown Menu?

No. The panels and rows are built from Dropdown Menu's recipe, not restyled here, so a menu opened from the bar and one opened from a button are the same object, and a change to one reaches both.

### Does it work on phones?

It works, but a row of menus is a desktop pattern: on a narrow screen fold the commands into one Dropdown Menu or a Sheet instead of squeezing the bar.

### Do the shortcuts do anything?

No, `MenubarShortcut` only shows the keys. Bind them where your app handles keyboard input, so they work whether the menu is open or not.
